description: White has just played e2-e4 past the black pawn on d4; the en passant target e3 is capturable by black only, and the black pawn's attack on the empty square e3 is a legal capture while the white pawn on e4 is not attacked on its own square.
decisions: An en passant target is recorded with the side that can capture it, derived from its rank: a target on rank 3 is capturable by black, on rank 6 by white. The pawn to be captured is the one on the square in front of the target from the capturer's point of view.
The capturing pawn's L0 attack lands on the target square, not on the pawn being captured; the pawn on e4 has no black attacker.
The capture is a legal L1 attack on the target square when it leaves the capturer's king safe, and the pawn's en passant special move is available with the target square.
The side that cannot capture reports en passant as unavailable with reason no_target.

assertions.note: Plain diagonal control of an empty square is also legal.
The pawn that can be taken en passant is not attacked where it stands.
